All 5 rows actually seen are imports (destination = India); zero rows with India as origin/destination abroad. Source counter: page claims 492 shipments / 13 trading partners / 18 ports; rows actually visible = 5, all import-side. GOOD LUCK INFRAFIN PRIVATE LIMITED: ImportKey pages for slugs 'good-luck-infrafin-private-limited', 'good-luck-infrafin-pvt-ltd' and 'goodluck-stainless-pvt-ltd' all returned the empty template ('Loading...' / 'Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records') with no shipment rows and no counters. Volza (https://www.volza.com/p/goodluck-stainless/) returned HTTP 403, so no second source could be read.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract or annual-report split could be retrieved. web_search (DuckDuckGo/searx) failed on every attempt with 'urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused', so no domestic-supply source could be located or read. Nothing to quote; field left null rather than inferred.
note: IMPORTANT: the only verifiable trade activity is IMPORT into India, not export. The company is an importer/distributor of stainless steel coils and pipe fittings (Vietnam, China, South Korea -> Nhava Sheva/Mumbai), latest record 2026-02-24. No export shipment with India as origin was found for either name variant. Declared HS codes 711590 and 721911 do NOT match any observed record: actual codes seen are 72202010, 72193390, 72193320, 72191300, 73079390 — per project rules this is not a rejection ground, the code should be corrected to the factual one (stainless flat-rolled 7219/7220 and pipe fittings 7307). Also note the claimed industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food/FMCG) is contradicted by the evidence: the goods are stainless steel, so the industry classification is wrong. Relationship between GOOD LUCK INFRAFIN PRIVATE LIMITED and GOODLUCK STAINLESS PVT LTD is NOT established — no shared address, CIN or shipment record links them; GOOD LUCK INFRAFIN has zero records on all three slug variants tried, so 'следов поставок не найдено' for that entity specifically. Revenue and export volume: null (not public in the sources read). No CIN/PAN retrieved. Search tooling was down for most of this run, so domestic-side verification is incomplete, not negative.
